abilities.name: Coin Toss
abilities.description: Invest 25 gold and hold up to 5 seconds to charge an aimed coin; successful hits may return investment plus profit.

cast.description: A gold coin flicked hard from a thumb, a clean metallic zing and short enchanted whistle. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: A golden coin strikes and rings, followed by a small satisfying shower of coins and magical success chime. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

charge.description: Five-second rising magical coin resonance, increasing pitch and brilliance with small metallic tremolo, ending cleanly. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Preview uses the maximum 5 second hold. Runtime can release earlier; charge frames can be sampled or held to match input.
80% return chance on hit,50% profit when returned; preview payout is a staged success, never a guarantee. No upgraded ricochet.

abilities.name: Dice
abilities.description: Instantly add one 1% critical chance stack, up to 50, persisting until a critical consumes the stacks.

cast.description: Two small ivory dice rattle in a hand and clack across wood, bright and tactile. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: Dice settle with a tiny enchanted luck ping, a precise golden note. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: This is a self-buff, not a projectile or immediate damaging attack.
Preview shows one successful stack addition; gameplay owns stack count, consumption and 500 ms cooldown.

abilities.name: Fortune
abilities.description: Grant nearby allies a 20-second luck aura improving gold and loot outcomes within two tiles.

cast.description: One warm enchanted golden aura opening, a small metallic charm vibrating into a soft magical shimmer. No money exchange, coins pouring, cash register, payout or victory flourish.

impact.description: One very short compact enchanted damage tick: soft golden metallic ping with a small dry low pulse and tiny sparkle. No coins, cash register, treasure discovery or currency payout.

sustain.description: Seamless restrained golden magical aura hum, warm sustained shimmer with soft restrained highs. No coin sounds, no cash register, no payout, no music progression, no attack or ending.

notes: Aura is economic support, not damage, healing or guaranteed loot.
38×38 accent does not define gameplay radius; range 2 tiles, duration 20 seconds, cooldown 45 seconds remain gameplay-owned.

abilities.name: Vault
abilities.description: Instantly place a 4×4 zone up to three tiles away, doubling critical-hit damage for occupants for 10 seconds.

cast.description: A heavy magical vault latch turns and opens with polished metal clicks and a golden resonant bloom. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: A clear gilded critical strike accent, bright metal ring with a compact treasure chime. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

sustain.description: Seamless quiet enchanted vault resonance, low warm shimmer with sparse delicate metallic chimes. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Buff zone activates immediately. Opening animation adds no gameplay delay.
76×76 canvas shows exact 4×4 cells. Base 10-second zone,cooldown 30 seconds; no fortress or defensive bonuses.
